My plot is very small, only a quarter of a timad, and beans are easier than cereals because they fix their own nitrogen. I have some DAP from the cooperative that I use mainly for my teff and maize, but for beans I will just put a little at planting to help them start — not much nitrogen is needed. I cannot afford pesticides and I have no irrigation, so I depend on the meher rains. I will use seed saved from last year because improved bean seed is hard to find here, and since the plot is tiny, my family can manage the work ourselves without hiring anyone.
